steps.title: Set up App Metadata and Package Structure
steps.description: Configure metadata details, package structures and ensure directory mapping matches com.roadcrossing.app

steps.title: Configure Project Build Settings in Gradle
steps.description: Establish settings.gradle with app module definition and compile settings

steps.title: Create Base Build Scripts
steps.description: Generate clean, modern Gradle scripts targeting Android SDK compileVersion 34 and minSdkVersion 21 with zero third-party dependencies

steps.title: Configure Manifest and System Themes
steps.description: Define the AndroidManifest.xml referencing custom native Material themes, layout parameters and launcher intents

steps.title: Setup App String Resources
steps.description: Create basic string definitions inside values/strings.xml

steps.title: Establish Fullscreen Native Material Style Theme
steps.description: Generate native styles.xml that implements full-screen non-AppCompat Material style themes

steps.title: Implement Game Overlay Layouts
steps.description: Create layout view hierarchy containing custom canvas container, interactive on-screen controls, HUD indicator, Home & Pause menus

steps.title: Create Player Entity Model with Procedural Chicken Style Drawing
steps.description: Code the Player class managing physics positions, interpolation, and drawing layers (feathers, comb, eyes, beak, feet, shadow, flash effects)

steps.title: Define Vehicle Entity Model with Detailed Types
steps.description: Develop Vehicle class supporting different car speeds, widths, styles (truck, taxi, sedan, fast sports car) and headlight lighting drawings

steps.title: Define Procedural Lane Model with Road and Grass Visuals
steps.description: Construct dynamic Lane objects, generating grass zones with detailed trees, and road zones with yellow lines and dashed central dividers

steps.title: Implement Game Loop Runner using Background Thread
steps.description: Create high-performance synchronized Thread loop that handles constant delta physics update rates and postInvalidates visual updates

steps.title: Create main GameView and Camera Manager
steps.description: Define GameView to manage procedural generation, safe lane transitions, camera offset interpolations, screen shake mechanics, and draw passes

steps.title: Establish Main Activity Controller and Event Callbacks
steps.description: Program MainActivity orchestrating state UI visibility, saving high scores through SharedPreferences, gesture swipes, and d-pad triggers

steps.title: Verify code compilation compatibility
steps.description: Check for correct imports, syntax alignments, and Java 8 rules compatibility across all entities

steps.title: Building Road Crossing
steps.description: Run assembly tasks and finalize project setup ready for installation
